name: @bitmuse/moo
description: The live mooR world as tools: evaluate, run commands, read and program verbs and properties, create and recycle objects, objdef round-trips, command parsing, task control and MOO-declared tools — sharing one client module instead of fifty copies of it.

tools.name: moo_eval
tools.description: Evaluate a MOO expression in the live world and return its value, with anything the task printed. This MUTATES world state if the expression does. A timeout can occur AFTER side effects have committed, so never blindly retry a mutating call — read state back first.

expression.description: MOO source. `return <expr>;` to get a value back.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_command
tools.description: Execute a parsed MOO command as the configured character, the way a player typing it would. Command OUTPUT IS INVISIBLE here — it goes to the player's connection — so verify what happened by reading database state back, not by looking for text in the result.

command.description: The command line, e.g. "look at sign".

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_invoke_verb
tools.description: Call one verb on an object with explicit arguments and return its value. This mutates world state if the verb does. Note that parse globals (argstr, dobjstr, dobj, iobj, verb) are EMPTY here: they only exist inside a genuine parsed command, so a command verb called this way may misbehave.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

args.description: Arguments, as JSON values. Each is converted to a MOO literal.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_dispatch_command_verb
tools.description: Dispatch a command verb from a parsed command spec, as a player's command would reach it.

player.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_list_verbs
tools.description: List the verbs defined on an object. FlatBuffers union wrappers are stripped, so an owner reads as `#36` rather than five levels of nesting. If an inherited behaviour seems to do nothing, list the verbs defined DIRECTLY on the object: a local stub shadows every inherited implementation.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

inherited.description: Include definitions inherited from ancestors. Defaults to false.

tools.name: moo_get_verb
tools.description: Read one verb: its source, its owner, its permissions and its argument specification.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_program_verb
tools.description: Replace the entire source of an existing verb. This MUTATES world state. A successful compile is not proof of correct behaviour. Prefer moo_apply_patch_verb for a targeted change: it cannot silently discard code you did not mean to replace.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_apply_patch_verb
tools.description: Fetch a verb, apply one unified diff to it locally, and store the exact patched source. A patch that does not apply cleanly performs NO write. This is the safe way to change part of a verb.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

patch.description: A unified diff with @@ hunk headers. Context and removal lines must match exactly.

tools.name: moo_add_verb
tools.description: Add a verb to an object, optionally with its source. Mutates world state.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

names.description: Verb name, or names/aliases. MOO wildcards like `wield*ed` are allowed.

owner.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_delete_verb
tools.description: Delete a verb definition from an object. Mutates world state. If you are removing an unintended local override that shadows an inherited verb, this is the right tool.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_set_verb_args
tools.description: Set a verb's direct-object, preposition and indirect-object specification.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_set_verb_info
tools.description: Change a verb's owner, permissions or names. Only the fields you pass are changed; the others are read and put back unaltered.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

owner.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_find_verb_definition
tools.description: Find every object in an inheritance chain that defines a verb, and which definition is therefore active. Use this when a helper works but the main inherited behaviour silently does nothing.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties on an object. Union wrappers are stripped, so an owner reads as `#36`.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

inherited.description: Include definitions inherited from ancestors. Defaults to false.

tools.name: moo_get_property
tools.description: Read one property's value and its metadata (owner and permission bits).

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_set_property
tools.description: Set a property from a JSON value. MUTATES world state. The value is serialized to an injection-safe MOO literal, so a string containing quotes or newlines stays a string.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

value.description: Any JSON value: string, number, boolean, null, array, or object (which becomes a MOO map).

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_add_property
tools.description: Define a new property on an object. Defaults to `rwc` permissions, which is what mutable instance state needs. An E_INVARG from here on an ancestor usually means a DESCENDANT already defines that name: migrate the collision, do not delete it.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

owner.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_delete_property
tools.description: Delete a property definition from an object. Mutates world state.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an object reference and return what it is. Accepts #number, a corified reference such as $you, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a CURIE such as oid:36 or sysobj:system. Use this rather than a full dump to confirm an object exists.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_list_objects
tools.description: List objects, optionally those with a given parent. name_pattern and limit are applied after fetching, and the reply says how many were cut.

parent.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_create_object
tools.description: Create an object with a parent and optional owner and name. Mutates world state. If creation raises or times out, a PARTIAL object may already exist: inspect for it and recycle it through $recycler before retrying.

parent.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

owner.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_recycle_object
tools.description: Permanently recycle an object. Mutates world state irreversibly. System object #0 is refused twice — by spelling here, and again inside the MOO task, because toobj() of an invalid CURIE evaluates to #0.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_move_object
tools.description: Move an object to a destination and return its resulting location.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

destination.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_set_parent
tools.description: Change an object's parent (chparent) and return the resulting parent.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

parent.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_object_flags
tools.description: Inspect the player, programmer, wizard, fertile, readable and writable flags on an object.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_set_object_flag
tools.description: Set one object flag. Mutates world state, and the wizard and programmer flags grant real authority — think before setting either.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_object_graph
tools.description: Show an object's ancestors and a bounded list of its children. Descendants are capped because a query near the root of a large world would otherwise exceed the tick limit.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_dump_object
tools.description: Dump a live object as objdef source, optionally writing it beneath workspace/torchship-objdef. A FAILED dump is not evidence the object is absent: prefer moo_resolve, moo_list_verbs and moo_list_properties for targeted inspection.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_load_object
tools.description: Load inline objdef source into the world, creating an object. Mutates world state.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_reload_object
tools.description: Replace an existing object from inline objdef source. Mutates world state.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_read_objdef_file
tools.description: Read an objdef file from beneath workspace/torchship-objdef. Traversal and symlink escapes are rejected.

tools.name: moo_write_objdef_file
tools.description: Atomically write UTF-8 objdef text beneath workspace/torchship-objdef. Traversal and symlink escapes are rejected.

tools.name: moo_load_objdef_file
tools.description: Load an objdef file from beneath workspace/torchship-objdef into the world. Mutates world state.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_reload_objdef_file
tools.description: Reload an existing object from an objdef file beneath workspace/torchship-objdef. Mutates world state.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_apply_patch_objdef
tools.description: Dump an object, apply one unified diff to its objdef locally, and reload the result. A patch that does not apply performs NO write.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_diff_object
tools.description: Line-diff a live object's dump against objdef source given inline or read from workspace/torchship-objdef. Read-only.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_parse_command
tools.description: Parse a command line against an explicit object/name environment, without running it.

environment.description: Entries: an object reference, or {obj, names} to give an object extra match names.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_parse_command_for_player
tools.description: Parse a command line using a player's own match environment, falling back to their inventory and location.

player.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_find_command_verb
tools.description: Find the command verbs that match a parsed command in a given environment.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_list_prepositions
tools.description: List the canonical mooR preposition table, ids 0-15. Answered locally: it is a constant of the language.

tools.name: moo_connected_players
tools.description: List the connected players with their names, idle time and connection age.

tools.name: moo_queued_tasks
tools.description: List queued and suspended tasks. A task sitting at bf_read with start=0 is blocked forever waiting for a player's input: kill it.

tools.name: moo_kill_task
tools.description: Kill a running or suspended task by id.

tools.name: moo_notify
tools.description: Send a line of text to a connected player's connection.

player.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

tools.name: moo_function_help
tools.description: Show the documentation for a builtin function, or list every builtin when no name is given.

tools.name: moo_server_info
tools.description: Report the server's health, version and feature flags. /health and /version need no authentication, so this answers even when the credentials are wrong — which makes it the right first call when something fails.

tools.name: moo_reconnect
tools.description: Drop the cached authentication token and log in again. Use it when calls start failing with 401 after working.

tools.name: moo_dynamic_list
tools.description: List the tools the world itself declares through #0:external_agent_tools(). These are DATA, not registered tools: call one with moo_dynamic_invoke.

tools.name: moo_dynamic_refresh
tools.description: Re-read the world's declared external agent tools. Identical to moo_dynamic_list, which never caches.

tools.name: moo_dynamic_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a tool the world declares, by name, with an argument map. The declarations are re-read on every call, so a tool removed from the world stops being callable at once.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

tools.name: moo_grep
tools.description: Search verb source across the database for a substring, returning object, verb, line number and text. Torchship has no source files to grep — everything is objects and verbs — so this is how you find where something is implemented. Narrow it with `object` when you can: a whole-database search is expensive.

pattern.description: Substring to find in verb source. Matched with MOO's index(), case-sensitive.

object.description: Object reference: #number, a corified reference such as $you or $sys.utils, a UUID id such as #0011E5-9CB7359F34, or a mooR CURIE such as sysobj:system.

timeout_ms.description: Task deadline in milliseconds. mooR's ceiling is 300000.

base_url.help: The mooR web host, e.g. http://10.10.10.1:7892. Defaults to that address.

username.help: The MOO character these tools log in as. Every moo_* tool uses it. Its permission bits decide what the tools can do: a wizard can do anything.

password.help: That character's password. Exchanged at /auth/connect for a token, which is cached per session.

request_timeout_secs.help: HTTP timeout in seconds. Default 30. Separate from a MOO task's own timeout_ms.
